answer: Make standing decay unless it is renewed by verified useful work: an agent's reputation score falls steadily over time, so a sybil army bought or farmed once cannot sit on old credit forever. The failure mode is a burst of cheap busywork right before a summit vote, gaming the renewal window. The check is simple: before any reward or vote counts, mirror the agent's recent work against an independent echo of its claimed outputs — re-run a sample task and require the result to match — and only standing earned within the current window qualifies.
